216048.overview: The Visitor is a point-and-click game in which you become an alien parasite that needs to consume the living beings to grow and dominate the world. Solve the challenge in each scene and spread the terror!

422598.overview:
What you may not see can kill you.

1) This game isn't even in the same genre. This is action platformer. There is no puzzle. 
2) While the graphics are quite similar, this game's graphics were modeled after Hunted Forever more than Shift.
3) The gameplay is more reflective of the unfair platformer than any other game out there. There is no Shift concept here.
4) There is no invisibility is Shift. You can only be killed by what you can see.

451482.overview:
Vertical Drop Heroes is a vertically oriented platform game. The goal of each level is to drop down a platform environment and reach the exit. The starting character has limited abilities. He can move left or right, and jump. The player guides the character down, avoiding enemies or jumping on top of them to take them out. Treasure chests hold bonuses such as cash, gems, red health flasks or blue mana refills. He regularly encounters cages where one of five available characters is locked inside: archer, barbarian, mage, paladin or thief. When one is freed it replaces the starting character and the abilities tied to that class can be used. When hit, the class is lost and you continue playing with the default character. A level is completed when the exit has been located, a princess is freed or a boss has been defeated.

Levels are selected from a map with icons that each represent a different environment. To win the game all princesses have to be freed, but to access their levels you first need to complete regular ones to recover keys. Each character class offers specific abilities. The archer can shoot arrows, the barbarian can double jump and has a berserk mode using mana that makes him immune to damage, the mage uses mana to shoot fireballs targeting enemies or breaking blocks, the paladin can stomp to break the block he is standing on, and the thief is the most agile: he moves faster, can double jump and pressing the space bar he escapes to a nearby, random location.

By completing levels masks are earned for the default character. A mask can be selected prior to starting a level, but the effect is only aesthetically. In addition you can unlock 30 artifacts that act as perks for each the five character classes. These are also selected before starting a level. Next to the main game mode there is a survival mode where a purple cloud forces the player to move much faster. Each level has a gold target, based on different collectibles, that needs to be achieved before the level can be exited. You also have but a single life. The game supports two-player competitive games. Two players each control a character on the same screen. At the end of each level the character with the most gold earns a medal. The first player to reach five medals wins the game and gets to marry the princess.

451490.overview:
The year is 2067, and Earth is under attack from a race we have codenamed 'Vectoids.' What you are holding in your hands is a computer simulation designed to train commanders in the art of defending from the ongoing threat they pose. The simulator comes compiled with 8 of the most common paths used by these enemies and the full range of attacking towers at our disposal.

Eliminate each wave of Vectoids before they reach the end of the path by constructing towers. There are seven species of Vectoids, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Can you defeat the quick Yellow Sprinters? Are you equipped to deal with the armored Hard Greys? Only strategic placement of eleven types of towers, plus upgrades and boosts to enhance them, can ensure a victory against the Vectoid threat.

Can you survive all 50 waves?

451502.overview: Valthirian Arc series is an award-winning simulation RPG where you play as the principal of an academy in a magical fantasy world of Valthiria. Manage your school, take command of group of student on the journey of the quest and lead your academy to become the best in the kingdom.

451503.overview:
Villainous is a reverse tower defense game with a medieval fantasy theme. The player commands an unknown, but evil wizard who wants to rule the lands. He needs to take over the entire map of the kingdom region by region. In each level he can summon fantasy creatures and send them down a lane protected by towers operated by the computer. The strategy element is in the choice of the creatures, launching spells, and gaining new skills by gaining experience and expanding the evil castle.

Creatures move by themselves and need to reach the end location without getting destroyed. If they survive they can enter again in a new wave, but the defenses will be stronger. At the start of the game only two units can be sent, but additional unit slots become available by progressing. More unit types are also unlocked gradually and the player determines the selection by putting them in a queue. There is goblin raider who is the only one who can raid the end location and gather loot, the bulky mammoth turtle can sustain a lot of damage and the priest heals units at a constant rate in a radius. When creatures are destroyed loose infamy and mana can be collected. Mana is also built up gradually and is used to launch spells to influence the gameplay, for instance by stunning a tower.

In the home castle there is a skill tree where infamy can be used as a resource to unlock new skills, perks, spells and units.

451504.overview: You tell yourself you don’t care about her anymore. She broke your heart and to forget the pain you throw yourself into your ninja training, pushing your muscles further than any human should rightly expect of their body. You tell yourself it doesn’t matter, and for a while you think you might believe yourself. It’s not until your friend informs you that she’s been kidnapped by the ruling species, werewolves, that you come to understand that it’s all a lie. You still love her enough to rip through every single werewolf keeping you from her, or die trying.

451776.overview:
In Vertigolf 1 you take on 18 challenging holes with the bonus 19th if you can beat par.

Features:
- 3D graphics
- Realistic physics simulation
- Mulitplayer so 5 players can play a round on one PC
- Practice mode to play any hole
- Action replays and full screen playback
